source.author: stat
source.text: ipsa suum genetrix curvo delphine vagantem abripuit frenis gremioque Palaemona pressit.
source.text_original: ipsa suum genetrix curvo delphine vagantem / abripuit frenis gremioque Palaemona pressit.
source.text_english: The mother herself snatched her own wandering child away on the curved dolphin and pressed Palaemon to her bosom with the reins.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: ille ubi se mediae per scuta virosque carinae intulit, ardenti Aesonides retinacula ferro abscidit; haut aliter saltus vastataque pernix venator cum lustra fugit dominoque timentem urget equum, teneras compressans pectore tigres, quas astu rapuit pavido, dum saeva relictis mater in adverso catulis venatur Amano.
reuse.text_original: ille ubi se mediae per scuta virosque carinae / intulit, ardenti Aesonides retinacula ferro / abscidit; haut aliter saltus vastataque pernix / venator cum lustra fugit dominoque timentem / urget equum, teneras compressans pectore tigres, / quas astu rapuit pavido, dum saeva relictis / mater in adverso catulis venatur Amano.
reuse.text_english: When he had plunged himself amid the shields and men of the middle deck, the son of Aeson with burning iron cut the moorings; no otherwise, when a nimble hunter, with the glades laid waste, flees the lairs and drives on his frightened horse, pressing the tender tigers against his breast, which he had snatched by craft from the terrified mother, while the savage mother hunts after her abandoned cubs on the opposite Amanus.
